title: 근황 말하기: 요즘, 바쁘다, 이사하다
objective: By the end, you can use words like 요즘, 소식, 이사하다, 결혼 and 졸업 in short sentences to ask how someone has been and to share your own news.
summary: Learn ten everyday words for catching up with someone and sharing your recent news in Korean.

task.title: Use the new words
task.line: Read each item, then choose, fill in, order, or answer in Korean using the words on page 1.

words.exampleMeaning: I often watch Korean dramas these days.

words.meaning: to be doing, to get along (how life is going)
a long time since last time; after a long while
words.exampleMeaning: On the weekend, I met a friend for the first time in a long time.

words.meaning: all this time, while we were apart
words.exampleMeaning: Sorry I didn't keep in touch all this time.
Did you hear the news about Jiyeong?

words.example: 이번 주는 시험 때문에 너무 바빠요.
words.exampleMeaning: I'm really busy this week because of exams.
Last month I moved to a place near the school.
My younger sibling got married last year.
After graduation, I'm going to go back to my hometown.
My older brother got a job at a bank.

exercises: Choose the right word (졸업 / 결혼 / 소식): 수진 씨는 내년 2월에 대학교를 ____해요.
Fill in each blank with 요즘, 오랜만, or 소식: ① ____ 날씨가 정말 추워요. ② 민호 씨, 정말 ____이에요! 잘 지냈어요? ③ 선생님께 좋은 ____을 들었어요.
Your friend says, "저 6월에 결혼해요." Choose the best reply: (a) 졸업 축하해요! (b) 결혼 축하해요! (c) 이사 축하해요!
Put the words in order to make a sentence: 바빠요 / 요즘 / 많아서 / 숙제가
Write the word from the list (졸업하다, 취직하다, 이사하다) that matches each situation: ① 대학교 공부를 다 끝냈어요. ② 회사에 들어가서 일을 시작했어요. ③ 다른 동네의 새집으로 갔어요.
Read the dialogue and answer in Korean: 민호: 그동안 잘 지냈어요? 지영: 네, 잘 지냈어요. 저 지난주에 부산으로 이사했어요. — Question: 지영 씨는 어디로 이사했어요?
answers: ① 요즘 ② 오랜만 ③ 소식
요즘 숙제가 많아서 바빠요. (숙제가 많아서 요즘 바빠요.)
① 졸업하다 ② 취직하다 ③ 이사하다
